instructions.name: claim
docs: Point at a revealed entry whose number nobody else revealed. The round keeps the
MAX_WINNERS lowest such numbers, in order. Anyone can call this.

instructions.name: claim_bundle
docs: Like `claim`, for number `index` of a revealed bundle. Anyone can call this.

accounts.name: tally
docs: The claimed number's tally; its round and number are checked in the instruction.

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Claim all accrued staking rewards to your wallet.

instructions.name: close_bundle
docs: Like `close_entry`, for a bundle: revealed refunds the player; never revealed forfeits
deposit and rent to the team wallet.

instructions.name: close_entry
docs: After settlement, close an entry to reclaim its rent. Revealed entries refund the
player; unrevealed ones forfeit their deposit (and rent) to the team wallet.

instructions.name: close_tally
docs: After settlement, close a number tally and refund its rent to whoever paid for it.

instructions.name: create_table
docs: Admin adds a table and opens its first round.

instructions.name: enter
docs: Pay the ticket from your wallet and seal a number. The number itself never goes on-chain
here; `backup` is the player's own encrypted copy so they can reveal from any device.
`max_ticket`: the most the player agrees to pay (the price the site showed them). The
keeper can adjust an open round's ticket, so a pick sent just before a rise is refused
rather than charged more.

accounts.name: referrer_token
docs: Optional: the referrer's token account, paid `referral_bps` of the ticket. Once a wallet
has a referrer, only that referrer's account is accepted.

accounts.name: profile
docs: `bind_referrer` on their first referred pick, checked there before it's read.

instructions.name: enter_bundle
docs: Like `enter`, for a bundle of `sealed.len()` numbers (1 to MAX_BUNDLE): pays that many
tickets and one reveal deposit. `nonce` and `sealed` are the player's own encrypted copy
(see the site's lib/commit.ts); `sealed` is overwritten with the numbers at reveal.

accounts.name: referrer_token
docs: Optional: as in `Enter`.

instructions.name: enter_bundle_from_stake
docs: Like `enter_from_stake`, for a bundle (as `enter_bundle`).

accounts.name: player_token
docs: Receives any leftover stake too small to keep staked.

accounts.name: referrer_token
docs: Optional: as in `Enter`.

instructions.name: enter_from_stake
docs: Same as `enter`, but the ticket is paid from the player's unclaimed staking rewards first
and then their stake. If what's left staked would be under the minimum, it's returned
to their wallet.
`max_ticket` as in `enter`.

accounts.name: player_token
docs: Receives any leftover stake too small to keep staked.

accounts.name: referrer_token
docs: Optional: the referrer's token account, paid `referral_bps` of the ticket. Once a wallet
has a referrer, only that referrer's account is accepted.

accounts.name: profile
docs: `bind_referrer` on their first referred pick, checked there before it's read.

instructions.name: fund_pool
docs: Anyone can top up a table's current pool (e.g. a treasury seed).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup: global config, the pool, reward and stake vaults, and the staking pool.

instructions.name: repick
docs: Change your mind: swap a sealed pick for a new one, until REPICK_CUTOFF_SECS before the
round closes. The old entry is closed (its rent and deposit come back) and a new one takes
its place; the ticket already paid carries over.

accounts.name: old_entry
docs: Closed at the end: rent and deposit go back to the player.

instructions.name: repick_bundle
docs: Like `repick`, for a bundle: swap it for a new bundle of the same size (changing one
number re-seals the whole bundle). The tickets carry over; the old bundle's rent and
deposit come back.

accounts.name: old_bundle
docs: Closed at the end: rent and deposit go back to the player.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: Open a sealed entry. Anyone may send this (the site or keeper does it for the player),
but only the right number + salt for this player matches the commitment.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for a new number tally if this is the first reveal of that number.

instructions.name: reveal_bundle
docs: Open a bundle: all its numbers, in order, and the salt. Anyone may send this. Pass each
number's tally account (["num", round, number]) as remaining accounts, in the same order
(a number twice in the bundle: its tally twice); new ones are created, paid by `payer`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for new number tallies.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Admin stops or resumes new picks on every table. Nothing else is affected: reveals,
claims, payouts, staking, unstaking and reward claims keep working.

instructions.name: set_table_enabled
docs: Admin switches a table on or off (off = no new picks, hidden on the site). A table can
only be switched off while its current round has no picks, so nobody's picks get stuck.

instructions.name: set_ticket
docs: The keeper (or admin) keeps a table's ticket near its dollar price from the price feed:
at most every `TICKET_UPDATE_SECS`, by at most `max_price_change_bps`. It applies to the
table's current round too while that round is still open (each pick pays the ticket of
the moment it's made; a pick's `max_ticket` makes sure nobody pays more than they saw),
and to every round after.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The keeper or the admin (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: round
docs: The table's current round: its ticket follows while it's still open.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Pay the winners (or roll the pool over) and open the table's next round. Anyone can call
this. Pass the winners' token accounts as remaining accounts, lowest number first, one
for each place that gets paid.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the next round's account.

instructions.name: stake
docs: Stake $UNIQUE. Rewards start accruing immediately.

instructions.name: start_close
docs: Give an open round that has picks but no close time yet its close: the next scheduled
time. Only rounds opened before v2 can be in that state (they waited for a minimum
number of picks; now the first pick sets the close). Anyone can call this.

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Unstake any amount, instantly. What's left must be zero or at least the minimum stake.
Unclaimed rewards stay claimable.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin updates the global rules (split, tiers, keeper, staking). The split and tiers
are copied into each round when it opens, so they apply from each table's next round.

instructions.name: update_table
docs: Admin changes a table's rules. They apply from its next round.

types.name: Bundle
docs: v6: up to MAX_BUNDLE numbers sealed under one commitment (see the header). `numbers` holds
them encrypted for the player's backup until the reveal, and the numbers themselves after.
Same layout start as Entry (round, then player), so the same filters find both.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Rules shared by every table.

fields.name: reserve_bps
docs: Share of each ticket that goes to stakers.

fields.name: referral_bps
docs: Share of each referred ticket paid to the referrer, out of the team's share.

fields.name: tier_min_entries
docs: Entries needed for 2, 3 and 4 winners (u64::MAX switches a tier off).

fields.name: tier_splits
docs: Pool split by place for 1, 2, 3 and 4 winners. Row k pays k+1 places and sums to 10000.

fields.name: team_wallet
docs: Receives forfeited reveal deposits (SOL).

fields.name: keeper
docs: May call `set_ticket`, and nothing else.

fields.name: max_price_change_bps
docs: Largest ticket price change `set_ticket` may make at once (2500 = ±25%).

fields.name: min_stake_tokens
docs: Smallest stake anyone can hold (keeps the reward math well inside its range).

fields.name: backlog_release_secs
docs: Rewards that arrived while nobody was staked are released over this much staked time.

fields.name: round
docs: The round account this pick belongs to.

types.name: Round
docs: Everything that decides how a round plays is copied in when it opens,
so rule changes never alter a round that's already running.

fields.name: close_at
docs: When entries close (0 until the first pick).

fields.name: legacy_max_seats
docs: v1 leftovers, unused (see Table).

fields.name: claims
docs: Lowest unique numbers claimed so far, lowest first. Empty slots have number = u64::MAX.

fields.name: all_revealed_at
docs: When the last entry was revealed (0 until then). Ends the reveal window early.

types.name: StakePool
docs: Staking totals and the reward-per-token index.

fields.name: acc_per_token
docs: Rewards per staked token so far, times SCALE.

fields.name: backlog
docs: Rewards that arrived while nobody was staked, not yet released.

fields.name: stream_end
docs: When the backlog finishes releasing (pushed back while nobody is staked).

types.name: Staker
docs: One wallet's stake.

fields.name: debt
docs: amount × index at the last sync, divided by SCALE: what's already been counted.

fields.name: pending
docs: Rewards earned and not yet claimed or spent.

fields.name: legacy_max_seats
docs: v1 leftovers (capped seats, number range, minimum picks): unused, kept in place so
accounts created before v2 still load. Always 0 from v2 on.

fields.name: ticket_set_at
docs: When `set_ticket` was last used (at most every `TICKET_UPDATE_SECS`).

types.name: TableParams
docs: One table's rules.

fields.name: ticket_tokens
docs: Tokens per pick, including decimals.

fields.name: period_secs
docs: Rounds close at `close_offset_secs + k * period_secs` (3600 and 0 = hourly at :00).

types.name: Tally
docs: How many revealed entries picked this number in this round.

fields.name: round
docs: The round account.
